Meet the professionals behind your smile.

Get to know the experience and approach described in the practice’s original dentist profiles.

The original clinic website lists these biographies, but its dentist page also contains West Bellfort practice details. Please call West Gray Dental to confirm which dentist is available at this location.

Dentist biography

Dr. Kim D. Ho, DDS

Dr. Ho graduated from the University of Texas Dental Branch in Houston in 1995. Her philosophy emphasizes continuing education, modern technology, and a conservative approach to care.

She speaks English, French, Spanish, and Vietnamese. Her original biography lists affiliations with the Academy of General Dentistry, Texas Academy of General Dentistry, American Association of Women Dentists, and American Society of Forensic Odontology.

Biographical details are from the clinic’s published profile; current affiliations and appointment availability should be confirmed with the office.

Published profile

Dr. Stephanie Aramwattananont, DDS

A Houston native, Dr. Aramwattananont earned her dental degree from the University of Texas School of Dentistry in Houston. Her published biography describes interests in aesthetic and restorative dentistry, prevention, and patient education.

She emphasizes helping patients understand their oral health and participate in treatment decisions.

Current practice at the West Gray location has not been independently confirmed. Please contact the office before requesting an appointment with Dr. Aramwattananont.
